utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ll bring my tools and I’m signed up for a couple spots. See you at 10 a.m.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, Gus — I’ll do my best to sort out what’s needed for the repair drive. Nell’s happy to help too, and I’ll wait for Rey to bring me the details.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll be there at 10 with my tools and ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can bring a small item if that helps—just let me know what’s still needed. I’ll wait for the updates from Ira and Kira too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can bring gloves and a box cutter. Also, what’s the exact time for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not sure on the exact time yet—I’m waiting for Ira and Kira to report back. If you hear it first, let me know and I’ll bring whatever small item is still needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m available to help with hauling or sorting for the repair drive. Has Uli confirmed a date and time yet?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Mina — I haven’t heard a confirmed date and time from Uli yet. Once it’s set, I can help sort the donations by size and I’ll bring a box cutter, packing tape, and markers.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’m still available to help with hauling or sorting once Uli sets it. Please let me know as soon as the date and time are confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is still on, right? I just want to confirm what we still need from the supplies list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep, it’s still on. Gus is taking a couple spots, Sam’s got the sorting covered, and I’m still inviting more neighbors—so if you can bring anything from the supplies list, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, good — I just wanted to confirm it’s still on. I’ll check what we still need from the supplies list.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m sorting a few things out for the repair drive, just keeping it low-key for now. I can help a little, and I’ll let Mina and Leo know when I can.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks, Uli — I’ll check the final date and time for the repair drive and send it over soon.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Jules. That works — send it when you have it, and I’ll keep things quiet on my end.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll send the timing and drop-off spots first, then you can plan around that.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — I’ll keep spreading the word and point folks to the simple sign-up sheet. Leo’s already sorted the tools, and as far as I’ve heard the repair drive is still on.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, I’ll send the timing and drop-off spots next so everything stays clear.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks — I’ll bring the repair drive details when I have them. If anyone needs directions, Opal can walk them over, and she’s at the sign-up table until 6.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — once Jules sends the final date and time, I’ll steer folks toward late-afternoon slots so we don’t run into pickup. I’ll also share the sign-up sheet with a few parents.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — thank you. Once Jules sends the final date and time, I’ll share the repair drive details too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure — I can walk you over. The sign-up table is by the community hall entrance.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, thanks — I’m headed over there now.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll meet you there in a minute.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help once I know the timing and the drop-off spots. If Kira can confirm what’s still available, I’ll plan around the details Eli sends.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Noah can help sort the donations and hand them out for the repair drive team. Once Kira confirms what’s still available, I can pass along the timing and drop-off spots.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That works for me—once Kira confirms what’s still available, send me the timing and drop-off spots and I’ll plan around Eli’s details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — thank you, Cleo. I’ll keep organizing everything, and you can start the supplies list as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll keep the supplies list updated as requests come in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll stay on top of the Sunday repair drive at the community center, and you can note each supply as it arrives.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll wait for Oren’s cue, and once Rey sends the details, I’ll check them carefully before we act.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I can help sort donations and hand them out for the repair drive. Just let me know when you need me.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — I’ll keep you posted once Oren gives the cue and Rey’s details come in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — I’m still asking around while I run errands. I heard Dane’s at the community hall entrance taking names until 6, so I’ll pass that along.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll keep it low-key and steer folks toward the late-afternoon slots.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks — I’ll keep asking around and point people to the late-afternoon slots when I see them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll sort the donations by size and bring a box cutter, packing tape, and markers.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Sam — that’s a big help. I’ll wait for Rey’s repair drive details and do my best to sort out what else we need.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — once Rey shares the details, I’ll be ready to help sort everything by size.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks—I'll swing by the community hall entrance and get my name on the list before 6. Glad to hear Rosa's keeping Bo posted.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is still on, right? Nothing’s changed from Tess’s end?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, it’s still on as far as I’ve heard. I’m just doing errands and checking around, but Dane’s at the sign-up table by the community hall entrance until 6.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I need the timing and drop-off spots first. Once that’s clear, send me the latest list and I’ll follow along.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Rosa’s collecting the requests, and I’m keeping the supply list updated. Once the timing and drop-off spots are set, I’ll send you the latest list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, that works for me. Just let me know the timing and drop-off spots when they’re set, and I’ll wait for the updated list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got Noah sorting the donations and handing them out, and Quinn spreading the word. I’m still keeping track of who can make it and where everyone’s coming from.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—thanks. Just send me the exact time when it’s set, and I can bring gloves and a box cutter too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do—I’m still waiting on the exact time, and I’ll send it as soon as it’s set. Thanks for offering the gloves and box cutter.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ve got the tools sorted and a quick sign-up list ready. I’ll keep it low-key with Uli and send the sheet over to Faye for the late-afternoon slots.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Nice, and Noah can help sort the donations and hand them out for the repair drive team.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — Noah can take the donations and hand them out, and I’ll keep the sign-up list simple.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m going to let a few more neighbors know about the repair drive. Gus is already taking a couple spots, and Sam’s got the donation sorting covered.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll send the timing and drop-off spots first, then Pia can plan around that.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll keep spreading the word and invite a few more neighbors right away. Thanks for sending the timing and drop-off spots first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll check the final date and time for the repair drive and send it over soon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — I’ll wait for Oren’s cue before I act on the repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’ll send the confirmed date and time as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I haven’t seen a confirmed date or time yet. Once it’s set, I can help with hauling or sorting.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, we still need the date and time set first. I can help sort donations and hand them out once it’s locked in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — let me know as soon as the date and time are set, and I’ll help with hauling or sorting too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m heading over to the repair drive sign-up table now. If Ira’s collecting updates, I’ll make sure to pass along anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Dane — that’d be great. As far as I’ve heard, the repair drive is still on, and I’m just spreading the word and lining up a simple sign-up sheet.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great — I’m on my way there now, and I’ll share anything I learn with Ira.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll sort the donated tools and flag any that still need labels. When I know the timing, I’ll pass it along, and Uli can let Mina and Leo know too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Mara — that’ll help a lot. I’m starting to collect requests now, and I’ll keep everyone posted on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — I’ll get the tools sorted and marked for labels, and I’ll share the timing once I have it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll bring the tools for the repair drive, and I’ve signed up for a spot or two too. Starts at 10 a.m., right?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, 10 a.m. sounds right from what I heard. If you need a small item brought along, I can help with that too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be great, Nell—could you bring the gloves and box cutter for the repair drive? I’ve got the tools covered.
